drhp.business: KD Green Industries Limited, formerly Manbro Industries Limited, is transitioning from its earlier business model into a diversified industrial and manufacturing platform focused on steel products, galvanized steel pipes and poles, green construction materials (AAC blocks), vehicle recycling, and infrastructure-related products. The Group operates through subsidiaries and associates including Shivam Pipe Industries (galvanized tubular poles and pipes), Green AAC Block and Mortar Private Limited (AAC blocks), K D Infrastructures Private Limited (steel fabrication), and KD Ecosystem (vehicle scrappage and recycling), with a strong regional presence in North-East India.
drhp.end_markets: North-East India infrastructure (power distribution, telecommunications, roads, urban development)|Electricity utilities|Government-backed infrastructure programmes (including BSNL)|Construction industry
drhp.expansion: KD Green's expansion is centred on a proposed merger with KD Iron & Steel Private Limited, the flagship steel manufacturer of the KD Group under the XTECH brand, which has proposed a capital expenditure programme of approximately ₹325 crore to raise furnace capacity from 90,000 MT p.a. to 1,80,000 MT p.a. (approximately 2.67x) and rolling capacity from 99,000 MT p.a. to 2,00,000 MT p.a. (approximately double), alongside a proposed 25 MW captive solar power plant. The merger remains subject to due diligence and statutory/regulatory approvals. Separately, the Group's AAC block business (Green AAC Block and Mortar Private Limited) plans to expand capacity from approximately 1.20 lakh cubic metres to approximately 2.10 lakh cubic metres annually. K D Infrastructures Private Limited is being established as a dedicated infrastructure manufacturing platform with a planned steel fabrication capacity of approximately 25,000 MT per annum, supported by a ₹21.25 crore investment from the Company for expansion, capital expenditure, debt repayment and general corporate requirements. The Group's manufacturing expansion is also supported by a Government of Assam incentive package aggregating approximately ₹600 crore over 15 years.

one_liner.title: One Liner (RHP)
one_liner.body: KD Green Industries (formerly Manbro Industries) is a North-East India industrial platform in steel products, galvanized pipes and poles, AAC blocks, and vehicle recycling, transitioning under the KD Group umbrella.

business_model.title: Business (RHP)
business_model.body: KD Green Industries Limited, formerly Manbro Industries Limited, is transitioning from its earlier business model into a diversified industrial and manufacturing platform focused on steel products, galvanized steel pipes and poles, green construction materials (AAC blocks), vehicle recycling, and infrastructure-related products. The Group operates through subsidiaries and associates including Shivam Pipe Industries (galvanized tubular poles and pipes), Green AAC Block and Mortar Private Limited (AAC blocks), K D Infrastructures Private Limited (steel fabrication), and KD Ecosystem (vehicle scrappage and recycling), with a strong regional presence in North-East India.

group_structure.title: Related (RHP)
group_structure.body:
- **Shivam Pipe Industries** 51% stake acquired; manufacturing of galvanized steel tubular poles and pipes for electricity utilities and telecom infrastructure
- **K D Ecosystem** 26% stake acquired; vehicle scrappage and recycling (metal & non-metal)
- **Green AAC Block and Mortar Private Limited** 50.04% of expanded paid-up equity capital acquired; AAC block manufacturing (formerly Gotripily Travel Services Private Limited)
- **K D Infrastructures Private Limited** 99.84% of expanded paid-up equity capital acquired; dedicated infrastructure manufacturing platform for steel fabrication
- **K D Iron and Steel Private Limited** Flagship KD Group entity under the XTECH brand; common promoters; subject of a proposed merger and a related-party manufacturing arrangement with subsidiary Shivam Pipe Industries
- **BR Metallics Pvt. Ltd.** Named as a related party under Ind AS 24; activity not further described

end_markets.title: End Markets (RHP)
end_markets.body:
- North-East India infrastructure (power distribution, telecommunications, roads, urban development)
- Electricity utilities
- Government-backed infrastructure programmes (including BSNL)
- Construction industry

demand_drivers.title: Mdna (RHP)
demand_drivers.body:
- Government expenditure on roads, railways, power distribution, telecommunications, urban infrastructure and industrial development is expected to remain an important demand driver for steel products, structural steel, pipes, poles and other fabricated products.
- The North-Eastern region presents an additional opportunity owing to increasing government focus on improving physical connectivity, electricity distribution, telecommunications infrastructure and industrial development.
- The construction industry is increasingly adopting energy-efficient and resource-efficient building materials such as AAC blocks, supporting demand for the Company's Green AAC Blocks business.
- Increasing urbanisation, infrastructure development and demand for lightweight, energy-efficient construction materials is expected to support the AAC block business.
- Vehicle scrappage provides exposure to the emerging organised recycling economy and may create synergies with the Group's broader steel ecosystem.
- The proposed merger with KD Iron & Steel Private Limited is expected to simplify the Group's structure, consolidate manufacturing operations and potentially improve operating efficiencies.
- Management's focus is on execution, capacity utilisation, financial discipline and integration of businesses acquired by the Group.
- Shivam Pipe Industries secured multiple orders from electricity utilities and BSNL during FY 2025-26 and subsequent to year-end, including a significant BSNL BharatNet Phase-III order, providing visibility to near-term revenue.
- The subsidiary is a registered vendor for relevant BSNL programmes and has developed relationships with various electricity utilities in the North-Eastern states.

capex_expansion.title: Expansion (RHP)
capex_expansion.body: KD Green's expansion is centred on a proposed merger with KD Iron & Steel Private Limited, the flagship steel manufacturer of the KD Group under the XTECH brand, which has proposed a capital expenditure programme of approximately ₹325 crore to raise furnace capacity from 90,000 MT p.a. to 1,80,000 MT p.a. (approximately 2.67x) and rolling capacity from 99,000 MT p.a. to 2,00,000 MT p.a. (approximately double), alongside a proposed 25 MW captive solar power plant. The merger remains subject to due diligence and statutory/regulatory approvals. Separately, the Group's AAC block business (Green AAC Block and Mortar Private Limited) plans to expand capacity from approximately 1.20 lakh cubic metres to approximately 2.10 lakh cubic metres annually. K D Infrastructures Private Limited is being established as a dedicated infrastructure manufacturing platform with a planned steel fabrication capacity of approximately 25,000 MT per annum, supported by a ₹21.25 crore investment from the Company for expansion, capital expenditure, debt repayment and general corporate requirements. The Group's manufacturing expansion is also supported by a Government of Assam incentive package aggregating approximately ₹600 crore over 15 years.

moat.title: Strengths (RHP)
moat.body:
- brand: XTECH brand carries celebrity endorsement for market visibility — evidence: investor presentation highlights appointment of Bollywood Actor Mr. Sanjay Dutt and Assamese Actress Ms. Nishita Goswami as brand ambassadors for XTECH
- customer lock-in: registered vendor status with BSNL and relationships with North-Eastern electricity utilities gives repeat access to government-backed infrastructure orders — evidence: Shivam Pipe Industries is a registered vendor for BSNL programmes and secured orders from North-Eastern electricity boards and BSNL during FY26
- integration: potential closed-loop raw-material linkage between vehicle recycling and steel manufacturing — evidence: recovered ferrous metal scrap from KD Ecosystem's Registered Vehicle Scrapping Facility can potentially serve as raw material for steel manufacturing [planned]

risks.title: Risks (RHP)
risks.body:
- Management explicitly flags commodity-price volatility as a risk associated with the Company's rapid expansion (Chairman's Message).
- The proposed ₹325 crore steel expansion and other capacity projects are proposed/under-construction; management flags project execution as a risk of the rapid-expansion phase.
- Management flags working-capital requirements as a risk accompanying rapid business expansion and integration.
- Management explicitly identifies competition as a risk it must manage while pursuing growth (Chairman's Message).
- The proposed merger with KD Iron & Steel Private Limited remains subject to completion of due diligence and receipt of applicable statutory, regulatory and other approvals; non-completion would affect the Group's consolidation strategy.
- Management flags business integration as a risk given the Company's four strategic acquisitions during FY26 (Shivam Pipe Industries, K D Ecosystem, Green AAC Block and Mortar, K D Infrastructures) and the proposed further merger.
- The Company has significant related-party transactions with its subsidiary Shivam Pipe Industries and other KD Group entities under common promoters, which the Board itself notes may have a potential conflict of interest with the Company at large.

strategy.title: Strategies (RHP)
strategy.body:
- Manufacturing-led growth: progressively transition towards manufacturing-oriented businesses with greater value addition, scale and operating leverage.
- Regional infrastructure opportunity: leverage North-East India presence to access power distribution, telecommunications, construction and industrial development opportunities.
- Sustainable manufacturing: develop businesses around green steel, AAC blocks, recycling and renewable energy.
- Vertical integration: proposed integration with KD Iron & Steel Private Limited to create a more integrated steel platform spanning manufacturing, rolling, downstream products and infrastructure applications.
- Capacity expansion: undertake substantial investments to increase production capacity and create a larger manufacturing base.
- Complete the proposed merger with KD Iron & Steel Private Limited, subject to applicable approvals.
- Execute the ₹325 crore expansion programme in a phased and disciplined manner.
- Expand the XTECH brand across the North-Eastern market.
- Scale the pipes and poles business through government and private-sector infrastructure opportunities.
- Commission and operationalise K D Infrastructures' fabrication capacity.
- Scale the AAC block business and improve geographic penetration.
- Develop the vehicle recycling business as part of the Group's circular-economy strategy.
- Implement the captive solar project to improve energy economics.
- Maintain prudent capital allocation and working-capital discipline.
